Gordon & Co. Ltd. (Sanitary Engineers) - termination of
strike.

134 fitters and coolies employed by the above firm, who
went on strike at 8 a.m. March 5, returned
at 7 a.m. today, March 7, after the management had promised to
give favourable consideration to their demand for an increase of
wages.

Riot at the Toong Sing Cotton Mill French Concession -
demonstrators dispersed by French Police.

down owing to trade depression, demonstrated in front of the
factory at 2.30 p.m. March 5 to enforce a demand for the payment

management were carried on for some time but without success,
the management refusing to go beyond $10.00 per worker. Towards
5 p.m. the crowd showed signs of rowdyism and the assistance
of the French police was sought. It is alleged by the French
police that at about this time ~~some unknown person~~ in the midst

pages.en:
March 6, 1930.

Labour

Gordon & Company, Ltd., (Sanitary Engineers) - Termination of
Strike.

110 fitters and coolies employed by the Gordon & Co., Ltd.,
No. 137 Szechuen Road, who struck work at 8 a.m. March 4, resumed
at 7 a.m. to-day, March 6, after the management had promised to
give favourable consideration to their demand for an increase of
wages.

Ziang Chong Silk Weaving Factory, 850 Rue Amiral Bayle:
Demonstration by employees: One demonstrator killed.

About 250 employees of this factory, which recently closed
down owing to trade depression, demonstrated in front of the
factory at 8:20 a.m. March 5 to enforce a demand for the issue
of a retiring gratuity of $100.00 each. Negotiations with the
Management were carried on for some time but without success,
the Management refusing to go beyond $30.00 per worker. Towards
10 a.m. the crowd showed signs of rowdyism and the Reserve Unit
of the French Police attended. It is alleged by the French
Police that at about this time some unknown persons in the midst
of the crowd fired one shot from a pistol following which the
crowd adopted a hostile attitude towards the police. Several
women in the crowd commenced throwing the contents of commodes
at the Annamite members of the Unit. When attempting to
relieve these women of their buckets, the Annamites were attacked
by the male elements who were armed with iron bars. In the
struggle which followed, attempts were made to deprive the
police of their rifles and in one case an Annamite policeman
to prevent his rifle falling into the hands of a demonstrator,
shot his adversary in the abdomen. This man succumbed shortly
afterwards. In other instances the Annamites fired into the
air and the butts of two rifles were broken in the melee.
One or two members of the crowd received minor injuries from
their fellows while three Annamite policemen suffered bruises inflicted
by iron bars. Order was restored at about 10:20 a.m.
pages.zh:
1930年3月6日。

劳工事务

戈登有限公司（卫生工程师）——罢工结束。

受雇于四川路137号戈登有限公司的110名装配工和苦力于3月4日上午8时罢工，在资方承诺对其增加工资的要求给予有利考虑后，于今日（3月6日）上午7时复工。

江冲丝织厂，贝勒海军上将路850号：员工示威：一名示威者死亡。

该工厂近期因商业萧条而关闭，约250名员工于3月5日上午8时20分在工厂前示威，要求发放每人100.00美元的退职金。与资方的谈判持续了一段时间但未获成功，资方拒绝为每名工人支付超过30.00美元。接近上午10时，人群出现骚乱迹象，法国警察预备队到场。据法国警察称，大约在此时，人群中的一些不明身份者开了一枪，随后人群对警察采取敌对态度。人群中的几名妇女开始向预备队的安南籍成员投掷便桶内的污物。当试图从这些妇女手中夺下便桶时，安南籍警察遭到手持铁棒的男性袭击。在随后的争斗中，有人试图夺取警察的步枪，其中一名安南籍警察为防止其步枪落入示威者手中，开枪击中对手的腹部。此人不久后死亡。在其他情况下，安南籍警察向空中射击，混战中有两支步枪的枪托折断。
一两名群众被同伴造成轻微伤害，三名安南籍警察遭受铁棒造成的挫伤。秩序于上午10时20分左右恢复。

pages.en:
Labour (2)

Four representatives of these workers later appealed
to the Social Bureau in the matter of their retiring gratuity.
The Bureau promises to take the matter up with the Management.
pages.zh:
劳工事务 (2)

此后，这四名工人代表就退职金一事向社会局提出申诉。
社会局承诺将与资方交涉此事。
